note: McCormick County and its Town of McCormick publish zoning only as PDF maps (county Land Use Map PDF, town ZoningMap2019.pdf). The county's interactive map is a ViewPro viewer (map.viewprogis.com) and GIS portal (mccormicksc.wthgis.com); neither exposes a queryable zoning service, and the viewer's configuration could not be read. The only ArcGIS Online item for the county (Clemson McCormick_Features) holds wetlands and sinks layers, not zoning.
